title: [CQ-V04c] Honest frozen gate outcome
description:
Objective: the wrappers' frozen-candidate quality gate never leaves a passing check run behind when the gate mutated its checkout. This is the host half of CQ-V04 DoD 2: "exit 0 followed by a tree/index/HEAD mutation is not a passing trusted result".

Split from CQ-V04 (task-a9d1a74d845b4d3d83f359bf864f8651) on 2026-10-29, at the human's choice in the architect REPL.

The defect today:
- scripts/moe-agent.sh run_frozen_gate (about lines 4602-4636) calls record_check_run_rpc BEFORE gate_integrity, and sends no outcome. The ps1 twin does the same.
- A gate that exits 0 but changes its checkout's tracked tree, index or HEAD is correctly refused for landing, but it still leaves an exit-0 'runner-observed' CheckRun.
- delivery/policy.ts passedOn counts that run under every strict deliveryPolicy, by the legacy no-outcome rule.

Contract (scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, in string parity):
- After the gate exits, run gate_integrity (sh) or its ps1 twin BEFORE recording.
- Send `outcome` in the CQ-V02 vocabulary:
  - 'passed' only for exit 0 with integrity intact;
  - 'inconclusive' for exit 0 followed by any tracked tree, index or HEAD mutation;
  - 'code-failure' for a nonzero exit.
- Everything else is unchanged: the run's id, candidate, tree, command and tail; the landing refusal and rescue on failure; the [WARN] lines; and legacy deliveryPolicy behaviour.
- moe-agent.ps1 stays UTF-8 with a BOM. Run bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh.
- Depends on every in-flight task that edits these files: CQ-V08 task-2720c13b (after CQ-V07), task-bdf6db6f, task-ad0dc2e7, task-c2a900aa and task-bc8410af. Build on their landed bytes and never revert peers.

Tests: modes in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and scripts/tests/postflight.ps1.
- A gate that edits a tracked file, stages a change, or moves HEAD, then exits 0, records 'inconclusive' and lands nothing.
- A clean exit-0 gate records 'passed'.
- An exit-1 gate records 'code-failure'.

Out of scope: the isolated check VM path (CQ-V04b), daemon policy (CQ-V04), and verified-local.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh
definitionOfDone: A qualityGate that exits 0 after mutating its checkout's tracked tree, index or HEAD records outcome 'inconclusive' and lands nothing, as today. Under a strict deliveryPolicy that run never satisfies required-check.
A clean exit-0 gate records outcome 'passed', a nonzero exit records 'code-failure', and the run is recorded only after the integrity check.
moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 behave identically (postflight.sh and postflight.ps1 modes), and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh passes.
Fresh verification `bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
scripts/moe-agent.sh: classify the frozen gate's run before recording it.

run_frozen_gate (about line 4602):
- Initialize GATE_OUTCOME="" beside GATE_RC.
- After `wait`, GATE_FINISHED=true and stop_gate_child, set GATE_OUTCOME:
  - `code-failure` when GATE_RC is nonzero;
  - otherwise `passed` when gate_integrity succeeds;
  - otherwise `inconclusive`. A failing or erroring integrity check fails closed to inconclusive.
- Then GATE_RECORDED=true and record_check_run_rpc.
- After recording, keep today's refusals, wording and order: a nonzero exit prints '[WARN] qualityGate failed (exit N); refusing branch commit.' and returns 1. A non-passed outcome prints '[WARN] qualityGate tracked tree/index/HEAD mutation; refusing branch commit.' and returns 1. Then the [OK] line and cleanup, unchanged.

record_check_run_rpc (about line 2256): pass "$GATE_OUTCOME" as one more argv and add `outcome` to the JSON only when it is non-empty (defensive).

finish_gate_observation (the interrupted gate, about line 4797): set GATE_OUTCOME=infra-failure before its record_check_run_rpc. An interrupted gate was never verified, and V02 coherence allows any exit code for infra-failure.

Error handling: every new path is fail-closed. Nothing new can reach 'passed' without exit 0 and integrity. The landing decision is unchanged: exit code first, then integrity.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. Record nothing on an integrity failure. Rejected: the run happened, and dropping it hides a mutation. Recording 'inconclusive' keeps the evidence and never counts.
2. Record exit code -1 on a mutation. Rejected: it falsifies the observed exit code. The existing hidden-mutation assertion requires the actual code.
3. CHOSEN: classify first, then record the CQ-V02 outcome. An interrupted gate becomes 'infra-failure', because it was never verified and V02 coherence allows any exit code there.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The landing decision already refuses a mutated gate. Only the evidence was dishonest: an exit-0 run with no outcome, which passedOn counts under the legacy no-outcome rule.
- Every mode also writes the untracked scratch.txt, and integrity must keep tolerating untracked files (diff-files sees tracked files only).
- gate_integrity rewrites the gate checkout's index flags (no-assume-unchanged / no-skip-worktree) before diff-files. It is a disposable checkout, so run it exactly once per gate.
- parity-check.sh compares MOE_* code families and fixed strings. Outcome strings are not MOE_ codes, so no list change is needed.
- The dependsOn chain covers every in-flight editor of these files: V08b, V08 (after V07), ad0dc2e7, c2a900aa, bc8410af and bdf6db6f.
planningNotes.risks:
- These are collision hotspots: build on the landed bytes of six prerequisite tasks and never revert peers.
- The embedded node suite lives in bash and PowerShell strings, so watch quoting and escapes (\\n) when adding modes.
- The head-mutation fixture commits inside the disposable gate worktree. It needs a test identity (-c user.name/email) and must not touch the shared checkout.
- pwsh may be absent in WSL; report honestly.

Mapping:
- exit != 0 -> 'code-failure';
- exit 0 and gate_integrity / Test-MoeGateIntegrity true -> 'passed';
- exit 0 and integrity false or throwing -> 'inconclusive' (fail closed);
- an interrupted gate recorded on teardown (sh finish_gate_observation, ps1 finally) -> 'infra-failure'.
